summary: Atlas PDKS first-iteration testing complete. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests PASS (auth, config, attendance incl. GPS radius, breaks, requests, admin RBAC + approve/reject). Frontend: Login → admin dashboard (metric tiles + last activity), Login → employee dashboard (greeting card, big circular punch button, stats container Bugün/Hafta/Vardiya, recent activity, Manuel Giriş Talebi button) all render. Tab navigation Ana Sayfa/Geçmiş/Talepler/Profil works. Register screen loads. Logout returns to login. Minor: RN web deprecation console warnings for shadow* and pointerEvents (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — non-blocking but should migrate shadow.card/shadow.strong entries in /app/frontend/src/theme to boxShadow for web parity.
React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — check components (likely inside react-navigation or Pressable) for pointerEvents prop usage.

action_items: Optional: migrate theme shadow.* helpers to use boxShadow for RN Web to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional: audit any pointerEvents={...} prop usage and move to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is 567 lines — approaching 700 threshold; consider splitting routers (auth/attendance/admin/requests) into modules soon.
All routes correctly prefixed with /api; MongoDB _id stripped via strip_id helper; env vars used without defaults for critical config — good.
Passwords hashed with passlib bcrypt; JWT signed with HS256 from env; RBAC enforced via current_admin dependency.
GPS Haversine implementation correct; check-in/out both re-validate distance against workplace radius.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all screens render; tab nav, login, logout, admin dashboard verified; punch/request submission UI present but GPS-dependent flows not exercised end-to-end from browser)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_-prefixed registered employees and pending/approved/rejected requests. Admin (admin@atlaspdks.com) and workplace config are auto-seeded on backend startup. Employee ayse@atlas.com (already in DB per test_credentials.md) used for UI flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_atlas_pdks.py runs standalone via `pytest backend/tests/test_atlas_pdks.py -v`. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Employee testIDs live in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/*.tsx: dashboard uses `punch-in-button`/`punch-out-button` (rendered conditionally on today.checked_in), `greeting-card`, `stats-container`, `new-request-button` (opens `request-sheet`). Requests tab uses `open-new-request` (opens `new-request-sheet` with `new-req-reason`, `new-req-time`, `new-req-submit`). Register screen uses `reg-name-input`, `reg-email-input`, `reg-password-input`, `reg-submit-button`. GPS check-in via web preview uses real browser geolocation — for check-in verification always use direct API/curl at coords 41.0082,28.9784.
